plan.encoding: ASCII canonical TSV with final LF
plan.repeatable_tail: db2 TAB exact-catalog-name TAB exact-FDID LF; alphabetical names, unique IDs
plan.offmesh_connections: Field must be absent; even an empty offmesh selection is unsupported.
plan.component_scope: Exactly DB2+all20 GT+raw-camera discovery; build70450 with wowdbdefs-70450-v1; resident only; no geometry, map-domain, terrain, navigation or offmesh.

identities.plan: SHA-256 of the complete canonical TSV bytes
identities.source: SHA-256(forever-logical-collection-v1 NUL + build little-endian u32 + build key + CDN key + locale ASCII + ENCODING content key + ROOT content key)
identities.source_scope: Authenticated logical collection; not physical archive availability or a complete archive snapshot; every read requires complete content MD5; MD5 is not a MAC or trusted provenance.
identities.keys: Decryption is disabled and no key-list input is admitted. The CLI forbids --keys; key names, values, counts, hashes and input paths are not placed in plans, package context, manifests, outputs, diagnostics, logs or errors.

limits.db2_before_read: min(16MiB,16GiB-actual_selected_bytes); checked subtraction; zero rejects before read/allocation
limits.camera_before_each_read: min(file_bytes,total_bytes_including_source_once-source_bytes-actual_camera_bytes); checked subtraction; zero rejects before read/allocation

resume: Explicit same-context only; verified sealed components skipped; the entire unfinished producer reruns and replays retained artifacts; the complete camera source must remain the sealed DB2 artifact; complete output refuses writes.

verification.db2: Complete bounded validation against the plan-bound wowdbdefs-70450-v1 catalog and exact selected name set.
verification.game_tables: Exact all20 catalog names and file caps;14 numeric parsed with fixed accepted policy, six opaque preserved.
verification.cameras: Complete all-inventory metadata preflight including source plus camera 256MiB budget, then target rediscovery and exact camera ID/name set; opaque bytes, not M2.
verification.metadata_preflight: Complete exact selected DB2 names and byte caps, exact20 GT files and byte caps, and every camera plus preserved source once<=256MiB before any payload read/hash/allocation; verify-links uses the same traversal; --keys is forbidden.

failure: Stable path-free code and component; incomplete outputs retained; no native, network, missing-file or encrypted-source fallback.

key_policy.keys_option: --keys is forbidden before client or key-path I/O

failure_envelope: forever-product-v19 after valid plan admission; generic CLI/plan failures before admission retain forever-product-v1; all errors path-free and key-free

legacy_preservation.v11: Build70374Db2GtCamerasV1; build70374; disabled or provided key policies unchanged
legacy_preservation.v15: Build70450CompatibleCollisionV1; build70450 compatible GNU15-v2; disabled keys
legacy_preservation.v18: Build70450CollisionProvidedKeysV1; build70450 compatible GNU15-v2 collision; provided-salsa20-v1

admission.metadata: admit_db2_70450: exact70450 typed bounded build metadata before bootstrap
admission.store: LocalStore::open_db2_70450 with disabled keys; existing narrow 70450 bootstrap
admission.raw_store_scope: Authenticated generic FDID bytes; product driver enforces exact DB2 catalog, all20 game tables and target camera source/discovery.
admission.platform: Linux only before client/output I/O; keys are forbidden
